takeoff.flight: Throttle's yours. Let's go scare some scenery.
Alright, hotshot. Wheels up, and try not to hit the only mountain out here.
Runway's clear, sky's clear. Everything else is your problem.
takeoff.war: Cleared hot. They already know we're coming, so let's not disappoint them.
Wheels up, guns hot. Somebody out there wants a fight. Let's give 'em one.
Rolling. Bandits inbound. Coffee's gonna have to wait.
foxtwo: Fox two. That one's got his name on it.
hit.wing: Left wing took one. Roll's gonna feel like wet cardboard.
Wing's hit. She rolls like a bathtub now. Adjust.
hit.engine: Engine's hit. We're down on thrust. Stop wishing, start flying.
Took one in the engine. She's tired. Nurse it.
hit.hyd: Hydraulics. She's heavy on the stick. Muscle it.
Lost hydraulics. Everything's gonna feel like it's underwater.
hit: We're hit! Felt that one in my teeth.
Taking hits! Quit sightseeing and move!
That one hurt. Get us out of his sights.
Hit! Don't fly straight, he'll do it again.
critical: Critical. One more and we're a lawn dart. Get it home.
We're falling apart out here. One more hit and that's the ballgame.
splash.1: That's one. Try not to get cocky.
splash.2: Splash two. Somebody's having a bad day, and it ain't us.
splash.3: Splash three. You're getting good at this.
Three. I'm starting to enjoy myself.
splash.4: Splash four. Okay, now you're showing off.
Four. Leave some for the rest of the squadron.
splash.5: Splash five. I'm running out of jokes.
That's five. You want a medal or a bigger gun?
splash.6: Splash six. I'm gonna need a bigger scoreboard.
Six. Their recruiter's gonna have a busy week.
splash.7: Splash seven. Are you even trying anymore?
Seven. I'll stop counting, you keep shooting.
splash.8: Splash eight. Alright, I'm impressed. Don't let it go to your head.
Eight. Okay, we're done here. Nobody's left.
wave.clear: Picture's clean. Breathe. There's more coming.
Sky's clear. Take five seconds. That's all you get.
That's the wave. Check your six, reload your nerve.
wave.home: Picture's clean. That's the lot. Take us home.
That was all of them. Let's go find something to land on.
Sky's empty. Home, and I'm buying.
rtb.ship: Return to the ship. Line up, call the ball, and don't embarrass me.
Ship's ahead. Fly the ball, catch a wire, and we'll pretend it was smooth.
rtb.base: Return to base. Runway's ahead. Ease it down, hero.
Home plate's dead ahead. Gear down, nose up, no heroics.
sam: SAM launch! Break, flare, and stop admiring it!
Missile off the ground! Flares, now! Beam it!
SAM! Break hard, hit the flares, go!
missile: Missile in the air! Notch it or flare it, but do something!
defeat.flare: Missile went for the flare. Dumb rocket.
Decoyed. That's why we carry those.
defeat.notch: It lost us. That's how you notch a missile.
defeat.cloud: It lost us in the weather. Told you I like clouds.
Missile's blind in this soup. Stay in it a second.
kill.radar: Radar's gone. Nobody's watching us anymore.
kill.sam: Site destroyed. That's how you drop a bomb.
SAM site's a crater. Good bombs.
kill.depot: That depot's gonna burn all week.
targets.done: All targets down. Egress, before somebody starts counting.
That's every target. Let's leave before they get organized.
two.lost: Two's going in. No chute. Damn it.
We lost Two. Get angry later. Fly now.
eclipse: The sun's going out. Not our problem yet.
Eclipse. Don't look at it, look at the ground.
moon.red: That moon's red. I don't love that.
moon: Look at that moon. Now look at the road.
Big moon tonight. Nice night for it.
Full moon over the deck. Enjoy it for one second, then fly.
bingo: Bingo fuel. Head for the deck, unless you enjoy gliding.
We're bingo. Home, now. Gliders don't get paid.
engineout: Engine's out. Congratulations, we're a glider.
Flameout. Okay. Trade height for speed and find something flat.
stall: Stall! Nose down, get the speed back!
She's stalling! Unload, nose down, now!
land.greased: Greased it. I didn't even feel that. Welcome home.
land.down: Wheels down. Welcome home. I've had worse.
We're down. Any landing you walk away from, right?
Welcome home. Nobody tell the maintenance chief.
laser: Laser's online. Point it at something you don't like.
We've got the laser. Go ruin somebody's afternoon.
winchester: Winchester. Guns are empty. Get creative.
We're out of bullets. Missiles or harsh language, your call.
bolter: Bolter, bolter! Power, go around, and stop looking at me.
Missed the wires. Power up, go around, try again.
trap.ok3: Three wire. OK pass. Welcome aboard, ace.
Three wire. That's the one. Nice trap.
trap: Trap. Welcome aboard. A wire's a wire.
We caught one. Not pretty, but we're aboard.
missed: Missed approach. Go around. No shame in it. Some shame.
Go around. Runway's not going anywhere.
gear: Gear! Check your gear, unless you want a belly ride.
Gear's up! Put it down before the runway does it for you!
rim: Below the rim. Nice. Now don't hit it.
Under the rim. Walls on both sides, hands steady.
six: He's on our six! Break now!
Behind us! Break right, break right!
Bandit's on our tail! Don't fly straight!
weather: In the weather. They've lost us. Shh.
We're in the clouds. Nobody can see us. Don't ruin it.
mission.fail: Mission failed. We'll talk about it on the ground.
That's a scrub. Debrief's gonna be a long one.
enter.valley: Entering the valley. The trees don't move. You do.
Valley. Forests, gates, and a whole lot of nothing to hit but the ground.
enter.shelf: Entering the shelf. Watch the terraces, they bite.
The shelf. Terraces and SAM sites. Stay in the folds.
enter.canyon: Entering the canyon. Walls on both sides and wind in between.
Canyon. The wind's gonna shove us around in here. Fly it, don't fight it.
enter.sea: Entering the mirror sea. Don't stare at your reflection.
The sea. Flat, wide, and shiny. Skim it if you're feeling brave.
enter.spires: Entering the spire forest. Crystal everywhere. Try not to become a windshield.
Spires. Big, pretty, and they don't move. Don't test that.
enter.ridge: Entering the ridge. There's a pass up ahead. Take it low if you're brave.
The ridge. Lift on the face, sink on the back. Mind the pass.
enter.graveyard: Entering the graveyard. Monoliths, domes, and things that don't like us.
Graveyard. If it's tall and dark, it's a rock. If it's shooting, it's not.
enter.reach: Entering the reach. Long way down from here.
The reach. High country. Watch the islands, they hang around.
train.0: Throttle up. Rotate when she's ready. She'll tell you.
train.1: Pull up. Climb through six hundred. Sky's that way.
train.2: Now turn. Drag the cursor out to the edge and lean into it.
train.3: Light the burner. Hold space and enjoy the push.
train.4: Roll it. Q or E. Don't overthink it.
train.5: Airbrake. Hold shift and feel it bite.
train.6: Thread a gate. Through the ring, not into it.
train.7: Good. Now bring it home. Line up on the runway, ease it down, and flare.
m1: First light. Three waves in the valley. Keep Two alive, then land it.
m2: Shelf strike. Four SAM sites on the terraces. Get low, bomb 'em, get out.
m3: Mirror. Two waves are coming for the carrier. Splash 'em, then trap aboard.
m4: Canyon escort. Two's hurt. Stay on his wing through the canyon, no matter what.
m5: Graveyard. Three radar domes in the monoliths. Kill 'em, then find the ship.
m6: Midnight. Three waves above the deck, then a night trap. Trust the ball.

two.hit.crit: Two's hit! I'm in trouble here!
Two's hurt bad! I can't take another one!
two.hit: Took one. I'm okay. Keep going.
two.tally: Two's got eyes on. Bandit, dead ahead.
two.wing: Still here. Still bored. Find me something to shoot.
